title: A number field hands the keyboard back when you are done with it
goal: Right now, once you type a width or a position into the inspector, the app keeps listening to that box. Pressing a tool key next types a letter into the number instead of picking the tool, and Escape does not help either: the only way out is to click the picture. Typing a number should end when you press Return or Escape, so the very next key reaches the tools like it always does.
notes: Found in the step E9 end to end sitting on 2026-09-03. Reproduced twice in Scripts/playtest/component-end-to-end-walk.json and redline-with-components-walk.json: after focus W / type 440 / key return, the log reports firstResponder _SystemTextFieldFieldEditor and a following key i never reaches the tool. Escape does not release it either; only a canvas click does. Fields are GeometryInspector.swift, Next only behind next-geometry-fields. Watch that Return keeping focus is what lets shift-arrow nudging work, so releasing on Return needs the arrow keys to still reach the canvas nudge or the field, whichever the design picks.
acceptance: After typing a number and pressing Return, pressing a tool letter picks that tool instead of typing into the field
Escape while a number field is being typed in puts the value back and hands the keyboard to the picture
Up and down arrow still step the value for as long as you are working in that field
A scripted walk proves the tool key lands, with the state before and after
